reason: The capture returned before Windows painted Quit in the active menu. These initial observations are excluded from the score matrix. Three fresh reviewers inspected both complete menu frames.

sol.label: Start with Windows
sol.detail: The visible Windows menu pairs an orange mouse with Open mouse settings and a checkmark with Start with Windows. Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping in the second frame.
sol.issue: 01-Windows-tray-active.webp shows blank space below the final divider, while 02-Windows-tray-paused.webp shows Quit Mushak there. The captures establish the visible difference only.

terra.label: Pause remapping
terra.detail: The native tray menu shows Open mouse settings, a checked Start with Windows item and Pause remapping or Resume remapping.
terra.issue: The active frame lacks the Quit Mushak item visible in the paused frame, so available commands appear inconsistent across states. Compare 01-Windows-tray-active.webp and 02-Windows-tray-paused.webp. The crop does not establish why.

astra.label: Pause remapping / Resume remapping
astra.detail: The native white tray menu uses a small amber mouse icon beside Open mouse settings and a check beside Start with Windows. The paused frame changes the verb to Resume remapping and visibly includes Quit Mushak below a divider.
astra.issue: Visible inconsistency in 14 Tray menu/01-Windows-tray-active.webp: the area below the second divider is blank, while 02-Windows-tray-paused.webp shows Quit Mushak there. Pixels do not establish whether this is a capture-timing artifact or a missing command, so the consistency deduction is limited to the supplied appearance.
